answer: New identities start at zero weight, so a attacker must fund and maintain many costly stakes simultaneously, with slashing forfeiting the full bond on any proven duplicate or collusion. Sybil resistance via bonded identity: each agent must lock stake on a public ledge before voting, and reputation accrues only through sustained honest work, like a velvet tide wearing stone smooth over many epochs. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
